_doc: Chapter 5 world geometry, in World B design units (the same space as the Chapter 4 restaurant). The Kerinti night is built ABOVE and TO THE RIGHT of the restaurant building, so the camera can travel there without a portal: up out of the management office, over the night city, into the Kerinti sky, down the Kerinti tower into its cut-away studio floor, and back up into the sky where the final QR assembles. Shared by the painters (scripts/art/chapter5-*.mjs) and the engine (lib/prototype/chapter5/*).

plates._doc: [x, y, w, h] design rect and pixels per design unit. Drawn above the night veil, in this order. The sky reaches down to y −2200 (the restaurant roof line) and fades in with st.night; the city plate is transparent above y −2450, so the two read as one sky.

building._doc: the restaurant's cut-away (Chapter 4); at night its interior stays warmer than the city around it

neighbours._doc: the exterior plate's neighbouring buildings (x0, x1, top) — at night their windows light up as square dabs

engineers._doc: bottom-centre anchors on the desk top (the sprites are cut at desk height)

drift._doc: where the operational modules float once they have left the manager's monitor (5.1 → 5.3)

qr._doc: the final QR card in the Kerinti sky: centre, module size, quiet zone in modules. The sky's big swirl is painted around this point, as Chapter 1's swirl was painted around the portal finder. quiet = 4 modules, the minimum ISO/IEC 18004 requires.

camera._doc: [x, y, zoom, yaw, pitch, roll] — same convention as chapter4/geometry.json
